dct_description_sm: Contributors: Blair, Robert W.; Data Distribution Laboratory (U.S.); Goddard DAAC (Goddard Space Flight Center); Short, Nicholas M.; United States. National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Scientific and Technical Information Branch.
Discusses various Earth and planetary landforms and landscapes, including their description, classification, origin, and development, illustrated with a rich collection of space images.
Previously published in paper ed. by NASA, available from Superintendent of Documents, 1986. Also available in web version.
Publication statement: [Washington, DC : Scientific and Technical Information Branch, National Aeronautics and Space Administration] ; Greenbelt, Md. : Distributed by the Goddard DAAC, c1996.
Requirements for Macintosh: 68020 processor or greater; 3.5 MB RAM (5 MB for Power Macintosh) availablle to Acrobat Reader; Apple System Software 7.1 or later.

Requirements for UNIX: 32 MB RAM; SunOS (4.1.3 or 4.1.4) or Solaris (2.3, 2.4 or 2.5); Open Windows (3.0 or later), Motif window manager (1.2.3 or later), OpenLook 3.0, or common Desktop Environment (CDE) (1.0 or later); 12 MB hard disk space for Acrobat Reader.
Requirements for Windows: 80386 processor or greater; 8 MB RAM (16MB for Windows NT); Windows 3.1 or later; 10MB (5MB for Windows 3.1 or 3.11) available hard disk space.
dct_title_s: Geomorphology from space a global overview of regional landforms
